# Kady No 1 Hair Braiding

> African hair braiding salon on Brook Road in Richmond, Virginia (legal name: Kady No1 Hair Braiding LLC). Knotless and box braids, boho braids, cornrows and stitch braids, soft locs, loc starts and maintenance, twists, kids' braids and color braids. Walk-ins welcome; book online on Booksy. Tagline: "No1 for a reason."

## Contact and location
- Address: 7601 Brook Rd, Ste F, Richmond, VA 23227 (Brook Road corridor, North Richmond, near the Henrico County line)
- Phone: (804) 261-0313 (call for appointments)
- Booking: https://booksy.com/en-us/1362588_kady-no1-hair-braiding-llc_braids-locs_134575_richmond
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kadyno1hairbraiding/ (@kadyno1hairbraiding)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/kadyno1hairbraiding/
- Website: https://kadyno1braiding.com/

## Hours
- Monday to Friday: 8am to 8pm
- Saturday: 6am to 9pm
- Sunday: 8am to 6pm, by appointment

## Reputation
- Google rating: 4.3 out of 5 from 290 reviews
- Themes clients mention: professional braiders, a clean and bright salon, neat braids that last

## Services and prices (from the salon's Booksy menu, September 2026; final price confirmed at booking)
Braiding hair is provided for most braid, twist and loc styles unless noted.

### Knotless and box braids
- Large knotless / box braids / boho / goddess (bra-strap length, hair included): $160, about 3.5 hours
- Knotless braids: $200, about 4 hours
- Medium knotless / box braids / boho / goddess: $220, about 4 hours
- Small-medium knotless: $260, about 6 hours
- Small knotless: $360, about 8 hours
- Box braids: $180, about 4 hours
- Extra-long box braids / knotless / boho (below the waist): $460, about 8 hours
- Micro braids: $260, about 5.5 hours; micro / mini braids: $460, about 8 hours
- Single braids: $120, about 2.5 hours

### Boho braids
- Boho braids: $220, about 4.5 hours (salon provides braiding hair; client brings curly hair)

### Cornrows and natural hair
- Cornrows, basic: $90; standard: $120; feed-in cornrows: $120; lemonade / tribal braids: $180
- Regular cornrows on natural hair: $60; box braids on natural hair: $60
- Men's cornrows: $40

### Locs
- Faux locs / soft locs (hair included): $200, about 4.5 hours
- Dreadlocks: $60, about 1.5 hours; styling braids or locs: $40
- The salon starts and maintains locs

### Twists
- Senegalese twists: $200; kinky twists: $230; spring twists (client brings hair): $200
- Two-strand twists on natural hair: $60; micro / mini twists: $600

### Kids
- Kids' cornrows: $60; kids' box braids: $140

### Extras
- Shampoo and blow dry: $30; detangle and blow dry: $30; beads or jewelry: $20
- Take out cornrows, weave or crochet: $30; take out single braids: $60
- Sew-in weave or crochet braids (client brings hair): $120 each

## How booking works
1. Choose your style, size and length on Booksy; price and duration are shown before you confirm.
2. We recommend arriving with hair washed, blown out and detangled, or add Detangle & Blow Dry.
3. Running late? Call (804) 261-0313 right away so the appointment can be adjusted.
4. The braider confirms the total before starting.

## FAQ
- Do you take walk-ins? Yes, walk-ins are welcome; booking on Booksy guarantees your time.
- Are you open Sundays? Yes, by appointment, 8am to 6pm.
- Is braiding hair included? For most braids, twists and soft locs, yes. For boho styles the client brings curly hair; for sew-ins and crochet the client brings hair.
- Is there parking? Yes, on-site parking is available.
- Do you braid kids and men? Yes: kids' cornrows, kids' box braids and men's cornrows.
